newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil police find bazooka in shantytown drug raid.
newsitem.headline: Brazil police find bazooka in shantytown drug raid.

text.p: Police confiscated a Swedish-made anti-tank rocket launcher during a drug raid in a Rio de Janeiro shantytown, a police spokesman said on Tuesday.

"It is the first time police have found this type of weapon in the hands of drug traffickers anywhere in Brazil," the spokesman said. "It has a target range of 250 metres (750 feet) and is used against tanks during war."
He said the drug dealers managed to escape.
The rocket launcher probably belonged to the Brazilian military, the spokesman said. Police also found a grenade, a machinegun, an anti-tank rocket and 3.3 pounds (1.5 kg) of cocaine.
